title: Does Fair Ranking Improve Minority Outcomes? Understanding the Interplay of Human and Algorithmic Biases in Online Hiring
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith/religion. It focuses on gender bias in online hiring.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the study.
